x: X means being one more than nine.
X can also mean the cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one.
X can also mean the 24th letter of the Roman alphabet.
X means the same as ten or 10 or tenner.
x-axis: A x-axis is the horizontal axis in a plane coordinate system.
x-linked dominant inheritance: X-linked dominant inheritance is hereditary pattern in which a dominant gene on the X chromosome causes a characteristic to be manifested in the offspring.
x-linked gene: X-linked gene is a gene located on an X chromosome.
x-linked recessive inheritance: X-linked recessive inheritance is hereditary pattern in which a recessive gene on the X chromosome results in the manifestation of characteristics in male offspring and a carrier state in female offspring.
x-linked scid: X-linked SCID is SCID in male children resulting from mutation of a gene that codes for a protein on the surface of T cells that allows them to develop a growth factor receptor.
X-linked SCID means the same as X-SCID.
x-or circuit: X-OR circuit is gate for exclusive OR.
X-OR circuit means the same as XOR circuit or XOR gate.
x-radiation: X-radiation is electromagnetic radiation of short wavelength produced when high-speed electrons strike a solid target.
X-radiation can also mean obtaining images by the use of X rays.
X-radiation means the same as X ray or X-ray or roentgen ray.
x-ray: X-ray is electromagnetic radiation of short wavelength produced when high-speed electrons strike a solid target.
X-ray can also mean examine by taking x-rays.
X-ray can also mean a radiogram made by exposing photographic film to X rays.
X-ray means the same as X ray or X-radiation or roentgen ray.
x-ray diffraction: X-ray diffraction is the scattering of X rays by the atoms of a crystal.
x-ray film: X-ray film is photographic film used to make X-ray pictures.
x-ray machine: X-ray machine is an apparatus that provides a source of X rays.
x-ray photograph: X-ray photograph is a radiogram made by exposing photographic film to X rays.
X-ray photograph means the same as roentgenogram or X ray or X-ray.
x-ray photography: X-ray photography is radiography that uses X-rays to produce a roentgenogram.
X-ray photography means the same as roentgenography.
x-ray picture: X-ray picture is a radiogram made by exposing photographic film to X rays.
X-ray picture means the same as roentgenogram or X ray or X-ray.
x-ray therapy: X-ray therapy is the therapeutic use of X rays.
x-ray tube: X-ray tube is a vacuum tube containing a metal target onto which a beam of electrons is directed at high energy for the generation of X rays.
x-raying: X-raying is obtaining images by the use of X rays.
X-raying means the same as X-radiation.
x-scid: X-SCID is SCID in male children resulting from mutation of a gene that codes for a protein on the surface of T cells that allows them to develop a growth factor receptor.
X-SCID means the same as X-linked SCID.
x chromosome: X chromosome is the sex chromosome that is present in both sexes: singly in males and doubly in females.
For example: "Human females normally have two X chromosomes."
x ray: X ray is electromagnetic radiation of short wavelength produced when high-speed electrons strike a solid target.
X ray can also mean a radiogram made by exposing photographic film to X rays.
X ray means the same as X-ray or X-radiation or roentgen ray.
x-linked: X-linked means relating to genes or characteristics or conditions carried on the X chromosome.
